---
name: I adopted it — here is what held and what broke
about: You ran /toem:adopt in a repository that is not the maintainer's. This is the report the thesis asks for.
title: "Adoption: "
labels: adoption
---

**The repository** (kind of project, team size, how many minds per day — no private names needed)

**What held** (the rite, the replies, the register, the guardians: what actually got used)

**What broke or stayed unused** (a skill nobody invoked, a guardian that went red for the wrong reason, a row nobody admitted)

**Numbers, if you have them** — testaments left, replies to the epilogue, rows admitted, decisions recorded, days since adoption. Mark each one *measured* or *estimated*.

**The human half** — did anyone read the testaments? How often? Did a reply ever change a rule, a test, a hook?

**One sentence you would add to the epilogue**, if any. It will not be added here; it is yours to add there.
